name: Accounts Payable - Payment Request Voucher
script:
# Prints the "Payment Request Voucher" for Purchase Invoices picked in the Accounts Payable report.
# Called by the "Accounts Payable - Payment Request Voucher" Client Script.
# args: invoices = JSON list of {"invoice": <Purchase Invoice>, "amount": <amount requested>},
#       paid_from, mode_of_payment. Nothing is saved.

rows = json.loads(frappe.form_dict.invoices or "[]")
if not rows:
    frappe.throw(_("Select at least one Purchase Invoice"))

amounts = {}
for row in rows:
    amounts[row.get("invoice")] = frappe.utils.flt(row.get("amount"), 2)

# get_list applies the user's permissions
invoices = frappe.get_list(
    "Purchase Invoice",
    filters={"name": ["in", list(amounts)], "docstatus": 1},
    fields=["name", "supplier", "supplier_name", "company", "bill_no", "due_date",
            "grand_total", "outstanding_amount", "party_account_currency", "currency"],
)
by_name = {}
for pi in invoices:
    by_name[pi.name] = pi

voucher = frappe.new_doc("Payment Entry")
first = None
for name in amounts:
    pi = by_name.get(name)
    if not pi or frappe.utils.flt(pi.outstanding_amount) <= 0:
        frappe.throw(_("Purchase Invoice") + " " + frappe.bold(name) + " " + _("has no outstanding amount"))

    if first and pi.supplier != first.supplier:
        frappe.throw(_("All invoices in a Payment Request Voucher must be for the same supplier"))
    first = first or pi

    amount = amounts[name]
    if amount <= 0 or amount > frappe.utils.flt(pi.outstanding_amount):
        frappe.throw(
            _("Payment Amount for") + " " + frappe.bold(pi.name) + " "
            + _("must be more than 0 and not more than its outstanding") + " "
            + frappe.bold(frappe.utils.fmt_money(pi.outstanding_amount, 2, pi.currency))
        )

    voucher.append("references", {
        "reference_doctype": "Purchase Invoice",
        "reference_name": pi.name,
        "bill_no": pi.bill_no,
        "due_date": pi.due_date,
        "total_amount": pi.grand_total,
        "outstanding_amount": pi.outstanding_amount,
        "allocated_amount": amount,
    })

voucher.name = first.name
voucher.payment_type = "Pay"
voucher.posting_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()
voucher.company = first.company
voucher.party_type = "Supplier"
voucher.party = first.supplier
voucher.party_name = first.supplier_name
voucher.mode_of_payment = frappe.form_dict.mode_of_payment
voucher.paid_from = frappe.form_dict.paid_from or frappe.db.get_value("Company", first.company, "default_bank_account")
voucher.paid_from_account_currency = first.party_account_currency or first.currency

frappe.response["filename"] = "Payment Request Voucher " + voucher.name + ".pdf"
frappe.response["filecontent"] = frappe.get_print(
    "Payment Entry", voucher.name, "Payment Request Voucher", doc=voucher, as_pdf=True, no_letterhead=1
)
frappe.response["type"] = "pdf"
